[h1] Cities: Skylines II Review [/h1]

[h2] Gameplay Experience [/h2]

Right amount of controls and buttons for starting out. More detail control buttons added after modding, which you [i]will do[/i] in this kind of game.
Keeps interest with mods. Base game quickly gets a bit shallow, as with every new game. Mod support severely extends lifetime.


[h2]Prese
Це та сама перша частина, тільки тобі треба заново купувати всі DLC. Не бачу якогось мега прориву за який треба вкладатись в цю гру. У наступній частині вам просто ярлик продадуть, все інше з dlc...

Worth it on sale.
Didn't play the game on release, but at its current state I enjoy it more than CS1. In the base game a lot of things are included which were behind DLCs (or only in mods) for its predecessor. I play it on GFN Ultimate so I had no problems with performance.
